items.title: Trang
items.subtitle: City in Thailand
items.description: Trang is a city southeast of the port town Krabi, in southern Thailand. It's known as a gateway to the beaches, islands and limestone mountains of Trang Province. Northeast of the city is Khao Pu–Khao Ya National Park. It's home to Tham Matcha Pla Won, a cave with a deep, fish-filled pool. Nearby is Riang Thong Waterfall. Southwest is Hat Chao Mai National Park, encompassing Ko Kradan’s island beaches. ― Google

items.markdown:
![The Ultimate Guide to the Trang Islands of Thailand](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07270321-1672-0139-0000-f8ab1c28148f:8)
Trang is `a quiet coastal province in southern Thailand known for stunning islands, amazing food, and a peaceful local vibe` . It sits on the Andaman Sea, south of Krabi, and offers great island-hopping without the massive tourist crowds.[](https://www.neverendingfootsteps.com/trang-island-guide-thailand/) [[1]](https://www.neverendingfootsteps.com/trang-island-guide-thailand/)[[2]](https://thecuriouspixie.com/things-to-do-trang-thailand/)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:16610792656473662716&ibp=oshop)[[4]](https://thailandinsider.com/destination/trang/)

Beautiful Islands

- **Koh Kradan** : Famous for clear water, white sand, and great snorkeling.
- **Koh Mook (Muk)** : Home to the famous Emerald Cave, where you swim through a dark tunnel to find a hidden beach.
- **Koh Libong** : The largest island in Trang, known for quiet nature and wild sea cows (dugongs).[](https://thecuriouspixie.com/things-to-do-trang-thailand/) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/MYyFddJ1Tuo)

Local Food and Culture

- **Dim Sum Capital** : Trang is famous for its early morning dim sum and Chinese-influenced breakfast culture.
- **Moo Yang** : Try the local crispy roast pork, marinated with sweet spices.
- **History** : The town has strong Hokkien Chinese roots and is where rubber first grew in Thailand.[](https://thecuriouspixie.com/things-to-do-trang-thailand/) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y3HPQKwMkxY&vl=en)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trang_province)

Travel Tips

- **How to get there** : You can take a 1.5-hour flight from Bangkok or catch an overnight train.
- **Best time to visit** : November to April offers the best dry weather for beaches and boat trips.[](https://thailandinsider.com/destination/trang/) [[1]](https://www.agoda.com/city/trang-th.html)[[2]](https://www.asiaglobalyachting.com/articles/island-hopping-the-trang-archipelago-thailands-best-kept-secret-by-yacht/)[[3]](https://openferry.com/destinations/thailand/trang-airport)[[4]](https://www.fabhotels.com/blog/places-to-visit-in-thailand/)

items.title: What is Trang like in Thailand?

expanded_element.title: Trang - Experience Travel Group
expanded_element.description: Thailand's Trang province provides serene, picturesque islands for relaxation, as well as authentic Thai culture and food in Trang town. It has fortunately not been touched by mass tourism, so it remains uncrowded both on the mainland and out on the islands.

items.title: Is it worth visiting Trang?

expanded_element.title: Is Trang Worth Visiting? - Thailand Starts Here
expanded_element.description:
Other FAQs About Visiting Trang
 Trang is definitely worth visiting if you plan to visit its paradise islands, which include Koh Mook, Koh Kradan and Koh Libong. The case is less clear when it comes to the mainland—it's charming and authentic, but maybe not very interesting to foreign tourists.

items.title: How do I get to Trang?

expanded_element.title: How to Get to Trang – Flights, Trains, Bus & Car Guide - Kupi.com
expanded_element.description: The city is served by its own airport, Trang (TST), which receives regular flights, primarily from Bangkok. The air gateway is located very close to the city limits, allowing you to reach the city centre in just 15–20 minutes. Flight time from the capital is usually just over an hour.

items.title: What is the best time to visit Trang?

expanded_element.title: Trang - The official website of Tourism Authority of Thailand
expanded_element.description: - The best time to visit Trang is between December and May. High and low seasons aren't clearly defined; some resorts are closed into the early high season (mid-November), while others start charging high season rates as early as October.
